text: S9 conversion QA handoff at EXACT SHA c83679ddda91f798fc8c97c9e621971188b2c7f9 on lane/e2e-conversion-qa-20260819 (base 5bb3fa9, tsc clean, payment authority untouched, no production mutation). CONTAINS ONE FIX: server/index.ts assisted-order bindingFor looked up an offering VARIANT id against an index keyed offeringId|offeringVariantId, so 0 of 417 bindings resolved - every order line projected unbound, prices suppressed, action degraded to request_pricing, and submit failed HTTP 500. After the fix submit returns 201 with a real XRR reference and correct pricing. FOUR BLOCKERS THIS LANE DOES NOT OWN, full detail in .xenios/handoffs/2026-08-20T14-55-00-000Z-LAUNCH-CONVERSION-QA-claude-fable-s9-conversion-qa.md and docs/research-launch/QA-S9-CONVERSION-BLOCKERS.md on that SHA: (P0) the order wizard never renders the four server-published formAcknowledgments so every submit is refused and NO user action can satisfy it - owner claude-fable-s3; (P0) Early Access unlock rejects the correct password unless RESEARCH_EARLY_ACCESS_OWNER_ID equals the hardcoded PRIVATE_ACCESS_DEFAULT_OWNER_ID, because register.ts never wires deps.ownerId - nonces are issued under one owner and exchanged under another, denial is silent by design; (P0) affiliate short links are unmounted so /r/CODE renders the public 404 and sets no cookie - every order this session carried affiliate_attribution_ref null; (P1) 35 Early Access routes are mounted as void handler() with no catch, so one rejected persistence call EXITS the node process - observed live, and placeOrder is registered the same way, making a database blip mid-order a site-wide outage. Widths 320/360/375/390/430/1366/1440 passed with no horizontal overflow and no off-screen CTA; duplicate submit correctly collapses to one order.
